fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Live game state in battery memory (unit, pilot, growth, stock and text work tables, map work). Save slots are copies of parts of it.
fields.evidence: save writer d000:A608 copies 24D1/2CFC/3053/33D3/0EC9 from here; work tables equal slot copies in saves

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Save-area signature, value 007B. Power-on rebuilds all slots empty unless both copies read 007B and the area sums verify.
fields.evidence: code d000:AE1E boot check; value 7B in all saves

fields.name: area checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum of the whole save area 33EB-741A: 16-bit sum of little-endian words, carry dropped. Copy at 7426.
fields.evidence: code d000:AF88 area path; recomputed on all 109 saves, all match

fields.name: Data 1: money
fields.meaning: Money shown on the save list.
fields.evidence: code d000:A608 <- RAM 0244; display d000:B1D4; value 1000000 in saves; screenshot shows 1000000

fields.name: Data 1: counter
fields.meaning: Second 32-bit counter, cleared at new game; 0 in every observed save. Feeds the record-score computation (value minus 2000000 scaled to 0-999).
fields.evidence: code d000:A608 <- RAM 096B; reset d000:9458/9D1E; read c000:8445

fields.name: Data 1: total turns
fields.meaning: Total turns; the screen shows this value plus 1.
fields.evidence: code d000:B0EE prints value+1; value 0 shown as 1 on screenshot

fields.name: Data 1: scene
fields.meaning: Current scene index (0 = scene 1).
fields.evidence: code d000:B046 reads it with base table d000:A37C; value 0 shown as scene 1

fields.name: Data 1: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown (part of story progress block).
fields.evidence: code d000:A608 copies RAM 08FC block of 32 bytes; 0 in saves

fields.name: Data 1: maps cleared
fields.meaning: Maps cleared in the current scene, one bit per map; the list shows set-bit count plus scene base.
fields.evidence: code d000:B046 counts bits + base from d000:A37C; 0 shown as 0 stages cleared

fields.name: Data 1: event flags
fields.meaning: Rest of the story progress block (event flags).
fields.evidence: code d000:A608 <- RAM 0900-091B; zero in saves

fields.name: Data 1: owner name
fields.meaning: Owner name copied from the console profile (A-Z = 0B-24, 00 pad).
fields.evidence: code d000:9D1E/9F44 read console words 0x30-0x37 into RAM 093B; save bytes decode to WONDERSWAN = console bytes 60-69

fields.name: Data 1: birth year
fields.meaning: Owner birth year from the console profile, BCD decoded.
fields.evidence: code d000:9D1E from console word 0x38; 0 with blank profile

fields.name: Data 1: birth month
fields.meaning: Owner birth month from the console profile.
fields.evidence: code d000:9D1E from console word 0x39 low byte

fields.name: Data 1: birth day
fields.meaning: Owner birth day from the console profile.
fields.evidence: code d000:9D1E from console word 0x39 high byte

fields.name: Data 1: sex
fields.meaning: Owner sex from the console profile (0-2).
fields.evidence: code d000:9D1E/9F68 from console word 0x3A low byte

fields.name: Data 1: blood type
fields.meaning: Owner blood type from the console profile (0-4); with the birthday feeds a per-pilot 0-5 value (d000:9CB8).
fields.evidence: code d000:9D1E/9F72 from console word 0x3A high byte

fields.name: Data 1: unit table
fields.meaning: 123 unit (robot) records of 17 bytes (fields below).
fields.evidence: code d000:A608 copies 123x17 from work table 24D1 via f000:526A

fields.name: Data 1: unit flags
fields.meaning: Per-unit flags: bit0 in your army, bit7 usable now (set when group mask matches); other bits unknown.
fields.evidence: code d000:4212 loop tests bit0 and +10 mask, sets bit7; values 0/1/0x69 in saves

fields.name: Data 1: unit index
fields.meaning: Own unit index (0-122).
fields.evidence: code d000:9458 writes loop counter; values match position

fields.name: Data 1: unit type
fields.meaning: Unit type id (default from ROM table d000:937C).
fields.evidence: code d000:9458 init

fields.name: Data 1: unit upgrades
fields.meaning: Six 4-bit upgrade levels, low nibble first.
fields.evidence: code d000:9458 clears; 16 units nonzero in saves

fields.name: Data 1: unit reserved
fields.meaning: Reserved, always zero.
fields.evidence: zero in all saves

fields.name: Data 1: unit pilot
fields.meaning: Assigned pilot index, FF = none.
fields.evidence: code d000:9458 presets; 45 assigned in saves

fields.name: Data 1: unit parts
fields.meaning: Equipped strengthening parts, FF = none.
fields.evidence: code d000:9458 fills FF; all FF in saves

fields.name: Data 1: unit group mask
fields.meaning: Story-group mask; unit usable when (mask AND group flags) is nonzero.
fields.evidence: code tested d000:4221 and c000:84B8; values 0/1/80 in saves

fields.name: Data 1: pilot table
fields.meaning: 95 pilot records of 9 bytes (fields below).
fields.evidence: code d000:A608 copies 95x9 from work table 2CFC via f000:52CA

fields.name: Data 1: pilot flags
fields.meaning: Per-pilot flags: bit0 in army, bit7 usable now; bit3 copied from a ROM pilot-table flag (meaning unknown).
fields.evidence: code d000:423C same rule as units; d000:9458 sets bit3 from ROM; values 0/1/9

fields.name: Data 1: pilot unit
fields.meaning: Unit ridden, FFFF = none.
fields.evidence: code d000:429A compares with battle unit; d000:9458 fills FFFF

fields.name: Data 1: pilot id
fields.meaning: Pilot id (default from ROM table d000:93F7).
fields.evidence: code d000:9458 init

fields.name: Data 1: pilot points lo
fields.meaning: Pilot points, low 16 bits (multiples of 500 seen; carry-over adds 500 per step).
fields.evidence: code d000:C8F3 word add; c000:84C0 reads +4/+6 as one 24-bit value

fields.name: Data 1: pilot points hi
fields.meaning: Pilot points bits 16-23.
fields.evidence: code c000:84C0/f000:8B3E combine +4/+6 then divide by 100

fields.name: Data 1: pilot unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown, zero everywhere observed.
fields.evidence: code d000:9458 clears; copied verbatim

fields.name: Data 1: pilot group mask
fields.meaning: Story-group mask (same role as unit group mask).
fields.evidence: code tested d000:4251; d000:9458 sets 1; values 0/1/80

fields.name: Data 1: growth table
fields.meaning: 448 16-bit growth levels: high byte base value, low byte accumulated level capped at 10. Exact subject (weapons/skills) unknown.
fields.evidence: code d000:9458 init high byte via f000:9E20; d000:9B04 accumulates low nibble capped at 10

fields.name: Data 1: item stock
fields.meaning: 20 strengthening-part stock counters, 0-7 each (first stays 0, rest have ROM defaults).
fields.evidence: code d000:C8F3 defaults from d000:C736; values clamped to 7 at c000:8524; matches ROM defaults

fields.name: Data 1: text
fields.meaning: Text strings in game character codes, FF-terminated (probably names). Encoding unknown.

fields.name: Data 1: group flags
